title: Daung Zen Tsang

page_data.en:
C. I. D.
I. O. REG
No. 401
Date 21/6/16

Shanghai Municipal Council.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

July 21st 1916

Sir,
The workmen in the Arsenal were paid yesterday in notes of the Bank of Communications. As these notes are at present at a discount, the operatives are grumbling a good deal.
General Yang gave a dinner to all military detectives and secret service agents in Shanghai yesterday at Loongwha. After the dinner the General thanked them for the good work they had done and said their services would not be further required. He advised those who were not under his control to return to the provinces from which they came and they promised to do so.
Daung Zen Tsang 震杜章 a high official in the Board of Finance has absconded from Peking with a large amount of Government funds. It is expected that he will come to Shanghai.
It is reported that the Chinese socialists intend to hold a meeting at 2 p.m. 21st instant in the building of a charitable society known as Tsoong Woo Sz Zen Wei 中華慈善會 in Nanyang Li 南陽里 alleyway opposite the Mixed Court.
Considerable dissatisfaction exists in Kuomintang circles with the official appointments made by Tuan Chi Jui. The Koumingtang intends to again advocate the use of force if Tuan continues to appoint monarchists and their sympathisers to office. In the event of hostilities the Kuomintang hope to be supported by Feng Kuo Chang.

Your Obedient Servant,

William Armstrong
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

Entries omitted.
page_data.zh:
刑事调查处
情报官登记册
编号 401
日期 1916年6月21日

上海工部局。

（印章：上海工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探股）

1916年7月21日

先生：

兵工厂的工人昨日以交通银行纸币支付薪水。由于这些纸币目前存在贴水，工人们抱怨颇多。

杨将军昨日在龙华宴请了在上海的所有军事侦探和密探。宴后，杨将军感谢他们所做出的良好工作，并表示不再需要他们的服务。他建议那些不受其管辖的人返回原籍省份，这些人也承诺照办。

财政部高官震杜章（音译）携大量政府资金从北京潜逃。预计他将来到上海。

据报，中国社会主义者拟于本月21日下午2时，在位于会审公廨对面南阳里弄堂内、名为“中华慈善会”的慈善机构大楼中举行会议。

国民党内部对段祺瑞所作的官方任命存在相当多的不满。如果段祺瑞继续任命君主立宪派及其同情者担任公职，国民党打算再次主张使用武力。一旦发生敌对行动，国民党希望得到冯国璋的支持。

您顺从的仆人，

威廉·阿姆斯特朗
首席侦探督察长。

警察总监上尉。

条目省略。
